title: The chore coat, retired
logline: The canvas chore coat — the 2000 one, the 2010 one, whichever's left — on a nail in the garage behind the plaid, its cuffs gone, October. The page draws it as the man it was.

panels.composition: A worn canvas chore coat hanging on a nail in a garage with a blue plaid shirt hung over it, the coat's cuffs frayed through, lamplight.
